notes.title: Now Tama-chan finds tresure chests!🦭
notes.notes:
Kemotaku Demo has been updated to v0.31!🦌

Tama-chan is now a rare card and her ability has changed.
Now she finds tresure chests!🦭

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078860/55f74fdff2d0f4285823ed979680395a975f2faa.png[/img]

Boss Lady went uncommon instead and her ability has changed a little bit.🐯

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078860/19f7e187b0f9ea940df9c31f1783b8be6b4311e9.png[/img]

Also I made a skill list page.📕
You can check the leader skills there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078860/7fd77b48783ef9815000f1f64a2f5e4e68c79211.jpg[/img]

And I made some other changes.🐶
I forgot what I changed though.

notes.title: Added background music!
notes.notes:
I added background music in this update(v0.24)♪
It's lo-fi hip hop beats. (not chill vibe)
If you feel uncomfortable, you can switch to nature sound in the option menu.🐱

notes.title: 🦌Updated🦌
notes.notes:

I've made a lot of changes like reducing the number of turns🐶
I think the gameplay is improved now that the redundancy has been removed.
